**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.05` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Inventory community-hosted datasets on open repositories and hubs, recording host-specific identifiers and revisions.

## Deliverables

- Inventory of community dataset hubs and their identifier schemes
- Candidate list with host revision identifiers

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/sources/community.md`
- `catalog/proposals/`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each candidate cites the host page and an immutable revision when one exists

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Host identifiers and revisions are recorded exactly as published
- [ ] Mirrors and re-uploads are flagged as distinct artifacts
- [ ] Candidates are proposals only

## Non-goals

- Downloading dataset files
- Treating upload counts as quality signals

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.05.T1` Inventory hubs
  - [ ] `DATA-02.05.T1.S1` List hubs and identifier formats
  - [ ] `DATA-02.05.T1.S2` Record each hub's terms of use
- [ ] `DATA-02.05.T2` Collect candidates
  - [ ] `DATA-02.05.T2.S1` Record host identifiers and revisions
  - [ ] `DATA-02.05.T2.S2` Flag mirrors and re-uploads
  - [ ] `DATA-02.05.T2.S3` Mark unclear provenance

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-02.01` Discovery method and source-use policy
- Blocked by `DATA-04.01` Dataset identifier and publisher model
- Blocks `DATA-07.03`

## Review requirements

- Independent dataset research reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

## Cross-repository handoffs

- None.
